text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Black: observed power. Blue: median forecast 24 to 48 hours ahead of arm R0 (trained with injected events). Orange: the same of the stored arm without injected events. Seed mean. Events with no label may sit in the lag inputs of the plotted rows.'
